sections.label: Singapore innovation ranking and RIE 2020
sections.summary: The Bloomberg Innovation Index ranks Singapore third globally and top in the region, while the RIE 2020 Plan directs $19 billion from 2016 to 2020 to four focus areas.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Finance and Chairman of the National Research Foundation (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
sentences.text: The Bloomberg Innovation Index has ranked Singapore as the third most innovative economy in the world, and the top innovation hub in our region.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Finance and Chairman of the National Research Foundation (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
sentences.text: The RIE 2020 Plan is directing $19 billion between 2016 and 2020 towards four focus areas: Advanced Manufacturing and Engineering, Health and Biomedical Sciences, Urban Solutions and Sustainability, and Services and Digital Economy.

sections.label: Aligning RIE with Future Economy Council
sections.summary: Aligning RIE with the Future Economy Council will accelerate economic transformation through programmes for Maritime, Aviation, energy grid, digital technologies, company growth and SGInnovate.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Finance and Chairman of the National Research Foundation (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
sentences.text: By aligning RIE’s efforts more closely to the Future Economy Council’s (FEC's) efforts, we will accelerate the deployment of solutions to enable economic transformation.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Finance and Chairman of the National Research Foundation (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
sentences.text: These include new programmes to support the transformation of our Maritime and Aviation sectors to sustain Singapore’s status as an international transport and logistics hub, and the development of a more responsive and resilient next-generation energy grid architecture.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Finance and Chairman of the National Research Foundation (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
sentences.text: We will expand our investment in digital and automation technologies, including robotics and artificial intelligence.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Finance and Chairman of the National Research Foundation (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
sentences.text: These investments support the FEC’s efforts to encourage adoption of digitalisation and automation across our economic sectors.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Finance and Chairman of the National Research Foundation (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
sentences.text: We will support the growth of Singapore-based companies through technology translation and knowledge transfer platforms, such as the Technology Consortia and Corporate Laboratory@University initiatives.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Finance and Chairman of the National Research Foundation (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
sentences.text: SGInnovate, a new entity started in 2016, has been expanding its accelerator programmes to support startups and growth-stage companies in deep-technology areas.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Finance and Chairman of the National Research Foundation (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
sentences.text: Working with economic agencies like Enterprise Singapore, it will support Smart Nation efforts in emerging sectors, such as Smart Energy, Digital Manufacturing, Fintech, Digital Health and the Internet of Things.
